name: tangible/ddd-symfony
description: Symfony host for tangible/ddd-core: bundle, Doctrine DBAL stores on Postgres, Messenger relay and delivery, advisory-lock processes, console operations.

suggest.symfony/console: Enables ddd:relay, ddd:schema:dump and the console-operator actor (D5); every Symfony app with bin/console has it.
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: Provides the named DBAL connections (tangible_ddd.connection) and the doctrine:// Messenger transport the relay shares a transaction with.
suggest.symfony/security-core: Enables SecurityUserActorProvider (D5): the audit actor is the authenticated user.

scripts-descriptions.refresh-siblings: Re-copy ../ddd-core and ../ddd-conformance into vendor/ (the path repositories use symlink: false, so edits there are not seen until this runs)
